program = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    if not points:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in points)
    perimeter = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)
                 if (r in (r0, r1) or c in (c0, c1)) and grid[r][c] != 0]
    frame = max(set(perimeter), key=perimeter.count)
    inner = [(r, c) for r in range(r0, r1 + 1) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)
             if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][c] != frame]
    fill = max(set(grid[r][c] for r, c in inner), key=lambda color: sum(grid[rr][cc] == color for rr, cc in inner))
    ir0 = min(r for r, c in inner)
    ir1 = max(r for r, c in inner)
    ic0 = min(c for r, c in inner)
    ic1 = max(c for r, c in inner)
    radius = max(ir1 - ir0 + 1, ic1 - ic0 + 1)
    radius = min(radius, r0, h - 1 - r1, c0, w - 1 - c1)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(r0 - radius, r1 + radius + 1):
        for c in range(c0 - radius, c1 + radius + 1):
            if grid[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = fill
    return out
'''
